dialogues.jp: どうも、最近の音夢は態度がおかしい気がする。
dialogues.en:
After moving a step closer to adulthood, I lay on the bed
covering my head with the blanket. Moe-sempai had already
left.
dialogues.text:
After moving a step closer to adulthood, I lay on the bed
covering my head with the blanket. Moe-sempai had already
left.

dialogues.jp:
なるべく俺の側にいようとしているみたいだし、
まあそれはいいんだが、からかっても反応鈍い
し、戦闘力もあまり上がらない。
dialogues.en: Knock, knock.
dialogues.text: Knock, knock.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「会いに来たぞ朝倉……おおっ！？」
dialogues.en: "I'm here to see you, Asakura...... Wow!!"
dialogues.text: "I'm here to see you, Asakura...... Wow!!"

dialogues.jp:
入ってきたとたん、芝居がかった驚き声が聞こ
える。
dialogues.en: As soon as he came in, he spoke with a phony voice.
dialogues.text: As soon as he came in, he spoke with a phony voice.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「くっ……遅かったか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I was too late......"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I was too late......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「一昨日は、あんなに元気そうだったのに……」
dialogues.en: "You looked fine just the other day......"
dialogues.text: "You looked fine just the other day......"

dialogues.jp: 鼻をすする音が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: He sniffed his nose.
dialogues.text: He sniffed his nose.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「安心しろ。朝倉妹は俺がちゃんと引き取って、
　面倒をみて｛・・・／もらう｝からな」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. I'll adopt your sister so she can take care of
me instead."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. I'll adopt your sister so she can take care of
me instead."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……人を勝手に殺すな」
dialogues.en: "......Don't pretend like I'm dead."
dialogues.text: "......Don't pretend like I'm dead."

dialogues.jp: 布団から顔を出し杉並に視線を向ける。
dialogues.en: I pulled my head out of the blanket and looked at Suginami.
dialogues.text: I pulled my head out of the blanket and looked at Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっ、生きてたか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you're alive?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, you're alive?"

dialogues.jp: カラッとした表情で俺を見る杉並。
dialogues.en: He looked at me with a surprised face.
dialogues.text: He looked at me with a surprised face.

dialogues.jp: 「あたりまえだ」
dialogues.en: "Of course I am."
dialogues.text: "Of course I am."

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、俺が死んだとしても両親がいるんだ
から、おまえが引き取る必要はない。
dialogues.en:
Even if I die, he doesn't have to adopt my sister because we
have parents!
dialogues.text:
Even if I die, he doesn't have to adopt my sister because we
have parents!

dialogues.jp: 「何しに来たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you here for?"
dialogues.text: "What are you here for?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、約束のブツを渡しにな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I came to give you the thing you wanted."
dialogues.text: "Well, I came to give you the thing you wanted."

dialogues.jp: 俺の前に花束が差し出される。
dialogues.en: He placed a bouquet in front of me.
dialogues.text: He placed a bouquet in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「杉並」
dialogues.en: "Suginami?"
dialogues.text: "Suginami?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「似合わないぞ」
dialogues.en: "This is odd for you."
dialogues.text: "This is odd for you."

dialogues.jp: 寒気さえ感じる。
dialogues.en: I can even feel a chill.
dialogues.text: I can even feel a chill.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Is it?"
dialogues.text: "Is it?"

dialogues.jp: ベッド脇のテーブルの上に花束が置かれる。
dialogues.en: He placed the bouquet on the side table.
dialogues.text: He placed the bouquet on the side table.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、こいつをやろう」
dialogues.en: "Then I'll give this to you."
dialogues.text: "Then I'll give this to you."

dialogues.jp:
今度は、テーブルの上に立派な松の植木が置か
れた。
dialogues.en: This time, he placed a nice potted pine tree on the table.
dialogues.text: This time, he placed a nice potted pine tree on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さて、挨拶はこれぐらいにして、いよいよ本
　題に入ろうではないか」
dialogues.en:
"Well, enough of the greetings. Let's get to the main
point."
dialogues.text:
"Well, enough of the greetings. Let's get to the main
point."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「これが本題じゃなかったのか……」
dialogues.en: "I thought this was the main part......"
dialogues.text: "I thought this was the main part......"

dialogues.jp:
かなりのデス声で呟くも、ナチュラルに杉並に
無視される。
dialogues.en:
I muttered with a sarcastic voice, but naturally Suginami
ignored it.
dialogues.text:
I muttered with a sarcastic voice, but naturally Suginami
ignored it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今日、職員室から仕入れたホカホカの情報
　なのだが、なぜ朝倉妹は島外の学園に行く
　のだ？」
dialogues.en:
"I got this information from the teacher's room today, but
why's your sister going to a school outside of this island?"
dialogues.text:
"I got this information from the teacher's room today, but
why's your sister going to a school outside of this island?"

dialogues.jp:
あまりにも突拍子のない話に、思わず呆れた声
が出る。
dialogues.en:
My voice revealed my surprise at the unexpected subject he
brought up.
dialogues.text:
My voice revealed my surprise at the unexpected subject he
brought up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、聞いとらんのか」
dialogues.en: "What? You didn't know about it?"
dialogues.text: "What? You didn't know about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「聞いてないもなにも、そんなわけないだろう。
　何で音夢が、島の外の学園に行かなきゃなん
　ないんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"There's no way that could be true. Why would Nemu go to a
school outside of this island?"
dialogues.text:
"There's no way that could be true. Why would Nemu go to a
school outside of this island?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おまえこそ何を言ってるんだ。朝倉妹は他の
　学園に行く。これはれっきとした事実だ」
dialogues.en:
"What are you saying? She's going to a school off the
island. This is the truth."
dialogues.text:
"What are you saying? She's going to a school off the
island. This is the truth."

dialogues.jp:
意味もなく自信満々、自分の名前は杉並だとい
うのと同レベルで言ってのける。
dialogues.en: He spoke with confidence in his voice.
dialogues.text: He spoke with confidence in his voice.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まさか……知らんのか？」
dialogues.en: "You mean...... you really didn't know?"
dialogues.text: "You mean...... you really didn't know?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど。どうやら本件は極秘扱いだったか」
dialogues.en: "I see. I guess this was a top secret issue."
dialogues.text: "I see. I guess this was a top secret issue."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は何か納得したように頷く。
dialogues.en: He nodded as if he was convinced.
dialogues.text: He nodded as if he was convinced.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「では、俺は戻るとしよう」
dialogues.en: "Well, I shall go now."
dialogues.text: "Well, I shall go now."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おい待て、さっきの話はどうなったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what's up with what you just told me?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what's up with what you just told me?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「トップシークレットだ」
dialogues.en: "It's top secret."
dialogues.text: "It's top secret."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おいおい」
dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.jp: もう、充分話したじゃないか……。
dialogues.en: He told me enough about it......
dialogues.text: He told me enough about it......

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それに、こういうことは本人に直接確認した
　ほうがいい」
dialogues.en: "Plus, this is something you need to ask her in person."
dialogues.text: "Plus, this is something you need to ask her in person."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、杉並は扉の向こうに消える。
dialogues.en: He said, and disappeared through the door.
dialogues.text: He said, and disappeared through the door.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、他の学園に行く……？
dialogues.en: Nemu's going to a different school......?
dialogues.text: Nemu's going to a different school......?

dialogues.jp: ここ数日の音夢の不審な態度が頭に浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: I thought back to Nemu's recent strange behavior.
dialogues.text: I thought back to Nemu's recent strange behavior.

dialogues.jp: まさか……本当なのか……？
dialogues.en: Is it really true......?
dialogues.text: Is it really true......?

dialogues.jp: 言いようのない不安が、全身を支配していく。
dialogues.en: My body was being consumed by unspeakable fear.
dialogues.text: My body was being consumed by unspeakable fear.

dialogues.jp:
焦点の定まらない目を天井に向けながら、俺は
音夢がやって来るのを待つ。
dialogues.en:
I vaguely stared at the ceiling and waited for Nemu to show
up.
dialogues.text:
I vaguely stared at the ceiling and waited for Nemu to show
up.

dialogues.jp:
気付くと、面会時間の終了を告げる放送が館内
に流れていた……。
dialogues.en:
Before I realized it, the hospital was announcing that
visiting time was over for tonight......
dialogues.text:
Before I realized it, the hospital was announcing that
visiting time was over for tonight......

dialogues.jp: ◆杉並の報せ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Suginami's news◆
dialogues.text: ◆Suginami's news◆

dialogues.jp:
杉並が来てくれた。お見舞いが本題ではなく、
俺に質問があったらしい。その内容とは……。
dialogues.en:
Suginami paid me a visit because he had a question for
me......
dialogues.text:
Suginami paid me a visit because he had a question for
me......

dialogues.jp: 何故、音夢は島外の学園へ行くのだ？
dialogues.en: Why is Nemu going to a school outside of the island?
dialogues.text: Why is Nemu going to a school outside of the island?
